# sendio Provider

Manage [send.io](https://send.io) domains, webhooks, API keys, templates, marketing objects (segments, topics, contact properties), suppressions and agent inboxes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    sendio = {
      source = "send-io/sendio"
    }
  }
}

# The API key comes from SENDIO_API_KEY when api_key is not set.
provider "sendio" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) A send.io API key with full access. Defaults to the `SENDIO_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) API base URL. Defaults to the `SENDIO_BASE_URL` environment variable, else `https://api.send.io`.
